evidence_text: Environment Agency LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud metadata: official archive of highly accurate x,y,z LIDAR points; DTM/DSM time-stamped rasters are derived from the point cloud; ground and surface-object classes are present; data are supplied in 5 km survey-year ZIP files containing LAZ files aligned to the OS grid; EPSG:27700; 25 cm to 2 m terrain-model resolution range; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; survey coverage metadata records start/end dates flown; revision 2024-07-19; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints. Spatial join, raster/point-cloud sampling, materialization and height-difference calculation remain local-only.
